moments.title: I Cugini Invade My Home (Without Me)
moments.description: My friends and I call ourselves I Cugini—i.e., “The Cousins”—and this summer they decided to organize a movie night at my home in Salerno. The only problem is that I live in Copenhagen. For such a reason, they watched The Godfather on my couch while I joined them via video call (yes, I am the one on the phone). I have never felt so loved and so robbed at the same time.
moments.imageAlt: The Cugini gathered in Stefano's living room in Salerno with The Godfather on TV, holding up a phone with Stefano joining by video call from Copenhagen

moments.title: A Birthday in Prague with I Cugini
moments.description: For my birthday, I Cugini came from Italy to celebrate with me in Prague. I like this photo very much: all of us around the same table, having dinner in a medieval-style tavern. It was also the only time my cousin managed to manipulate me—and it was amazing.
moments.imageAlt: Stefano and I Cugini having dinner around a long wooden table in a candle-lit, medieval-style tavern in Prague
